title: AndroidAPS failed to get Juggluco readings without any errors
body: I noticed at 10:49 when I went to Bolus that AndroidAPS had not had blood glucose readings for 481 mins. Juggluco was working correctly. I fixed the issue by force closing AndroidAPS and restarting, so I suspect it locked up sonewhere. AAPS 3.3.2.1 Build: 937e2bccc9-2025.10.14 Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS Flavor: fullrelease Nightscout version: UNKNOWN [AndroidAPS_LOG_1762080514358.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23289940/AndroidAPS_LOG_1762080514358.log.zip)
